fixed.summary: Switching og.Physics.profile at run time works in every build, a published one included: each web module carries both rapier3d and rapier2d, so a 3D game can play a 2D minigame (and a 2D game a 3D one) and switch back. Before, a publish build had only its project's profile and refused the other.

added.summary: On the web physics is three modules loaded on first use: `physics`, and the simulations `physics3d` (rapier3d) and `physics2d` (rapier2d). A world loads only its profile's simulation. The cook records it in a scene's `modules` (from its `resource og.Physics { profile }`, else the project's profile), so og.scene.preload of a 2D minigame's scene fetches rapier2d before the switch (physics §2, loading §12).
